rationale: C07 plausibly supplied a material template for the child letter. Both thank a commission chair for a submitted report, praise the commission’s sustained and thorough work, characterize the report as a valuable contribution toward meeting a national need, extend appreciation to the chair and fellow commission members, and close with personal regard. C11 and C18 share the report-acknowledgment and commission-praise function, but their language and sequence are less closely aligned with the child.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Even a brief perusal of the brochure reveals most clearly the thorough and painstaking manner in which you, your fellow members, and those to whom you looked for assistance and advice, approached your task.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Because of the wealth of information and experience with this problem which your Commission has gained in its long studies and investigations
shared_material.explanation: Both emphasize the commission’s extensive, careful study and the collective work underlying its report.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am confident that, as the report is evaluated, there will be full realization of the contribution that the Commission has made in laying the groundwork for the further steps necessary
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your report will be of great value to all who are concerned with meeting this great national military need.
shared_material.explanation: The child adapts the parent’s evaluation of a commission report as a valuable contribution toward addressing an important national need.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I trust that this assignment has brought to you and each member of the Commission a great deal of personal satisfaction, and I assure you that I appreciate your splendid presentation of your recommendations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The expression of deep appreciation I feel for the long hours of effort that you and your associates have contributed in the preparation of the excellent report submitted to me has been too long delayed. May I as well convey my personal regards to you and to each member of your Commission.
shared_material.explanation: This is a close structural and linguistic parallel: appreciation for preparing and submitting an excellent report is followed by recognition of the chair and every commission member.
